title: Care For It

serves.summary: The child finds what is not being cared for in a classroom, park or home and fixes it (caps on, things put away, litter in the recycling or trash bin, water and lights off where nobody needs them) while leaving cared-for things alone, which shows care for shared materials and places and saving water and energy.

request.topic: Taking care of shared things and places, and saving water and energy
request.objective: Find the things in a classroom, park or home that are not being cared for and fix each one: caps back on, things put where they go, litter in the right bin, water and lights off where nobody needs them, while leaving cared-for things alone. (SS001-01-B, SS001-02-A, SS001-02-G, SS001-05-A, SS002-01-E, SS001-01-E)
